sentences.l2: 我有一件T恤，它是我的衣服里最喜欢的一件。
sentences.l1: I have a T-shirt, and it is the one I like best among my clothes.

sentences.l2: 这件T恤是蓝色的，上面有一个很有意思的图案。
sentences.l1: This T-shirt is blue, and on it there is a very interesting pattern.

sentences.l2: 图案是一只小猫，它正看着我笑。
sentences.l1: The pattern is a little cat, and it is looking at me and smiling.

sentences.l2: 我每次穿这件T恤，都觉得很开心。
sentences.l1: Every time I wear this T-shirt, I feel very happy.

sentences.l2: 这件衣服很舒服，夏天穿也不会热。
sentences.l1: This piece of clothing is very comfortable, and wearing it in summer doesn't get hot either.

sentences.l2: 我喜欢它的颜色，也喜欢它的图案。
sentences.l1: I like its color, and I also like its pattern.

sentences.l2: 我希望这件T恤可以一直穿下去。
sentences.l1: I hope this T-shirt can keep being worn.

sentences.l2: 它不仅仅是一件衣服，更是我心情的好伙伴。
sentences.l1: It is not just a piece of clothing, but even more a good companion for my mood.
